title: Consolidation: Thirteen Nationalities & Shared Cultural Heritage

sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can synthesize the historical and cultural heritage of Hungary's 13 nationalities and Jewish community.
I can accurately deploy reciprocal and distributive structures (egymás case forms, reciprocal postpositions, -nként suffixes).
I can discuss multicultural coexistence, minority rights, and nationality self-government institutions in fluent B2 Hungarian.
